title: Admin & Facilities Executive
summary: An admin and facilities executive keeps an office or plant running: housekeeping and security vendors, maintenance contracts (AMCs), the travel desk, supplies, and licences such as the fire NOC. The role usually sits in the administration or HR team and reports to an admin manager.
dailyDuties: Check housekeeping, security and pantry work against vendor service levels
Track AMC renewals and service visits for DG sets, UPS, HVAC and lifts
Book flights, hotels and cabs for employees through the travel desk
Renew trade licence, fire NOC and other statutory registrations on time
Order stationery and pantry supplies and update the admin asset register
Plan seating and office moves with the facility team
Prepare monthly admin expense and vendor reports

skills.expectation: Manage housekeeping, security and pantry vendors against agreed service levels
Track and renew maintenance contracts for DG sets, UPS, HVAC, lifts and fire systems
Keep trade licence, fire NOC, lift and shops registrations valid and run fire drills
Run the travel desk for flights, hotels, cabs and visas within the travel policy
Buy and track stationery, pantry stock and admin assets
Plan seating, moves and small fit-out work with the facility team
Keep vendor, AMC, licence and expense trackers in Excel
Write clear notices and talk with employees, vendors and landlords
Work with HR, finance, procurement and site heads on admin needs
Raise purchase requests and follow up on orders for admin spend
Collect quotes and prepare comparisons for new vendors
Track the admin budget against actuals
Complete vendor registration and paperwork for new service providers
